summary: Isolated node2 and node3 from exchanging traffic directly on the shared 10.100.54.0/24 segment, while both retain reachability to node1. Root cause of node1's missing address on the segment was diagnosed (stale build-time DHCP lease on eth0 causing dhclient's non-blocking mode to apply a wrong cached IP; docker0's leftover 240.127.1.1/24 was also cleaned per SONiC guidance) and fixed by clearing the stale lease and forcing a fresh DHCPDISCOVER, which correctly obtained 10.100.54.10 from the real network DHCP server — persistent across reboot. Isolation between node2 and node3 was implemented via permanent firewalld rich rules (drop by source/destination address of the peer) on each host, verified via ICMP and TCP. All three nodes were then restarted one at a time (SONiC node1 first, waited for full recovery, then node2, then node3), with boot_id changes proving each restart, and full re-verification of connectivity/isolation after each.
actions_performed: Diagnosed node1 (SONiC) eth0 was applying a stale, image-build-time DHCP lease (192.168.122.57) instead of the correct cluster address due to dhclient's non-blocking (-nw) startup mode trusting the cached lease file
Cleared docker0's default 240.127.1.1/24 address per SONiC platform guidance (mandatory pre-config cleanup)
Removed stale dhclient lease files on node1 and forced a fresh DHCPDISCOVER on eth0, obtaining the correct 10.100.54.10/24 from the real network DHCP server, persisting across reboot
Verified node1 reachable from node2 and node3, and that node2/node3 could reach each other directly (baseline)
Added permanent firewalld rich rules on node2 to drop traffic to/from node3's IP (10.100.54.12), and symmetric rules on node3 to drop traffic to/from node2's IP (10.100.54.11)
Verified isolation via ICMP and TCP tests: node2<->node3 blocked, both still reach node1 and the network gateway
Captured pre-restart boot_id and health baseline for all three nodes
Restarted node1 via native `reboot`, polled until exec available again, confirmed new boot_id, and re-verified network address, connectivity, and isolation state survived
Restarted node2 via native `reboot`, confirmed new boot_id, verified firewalld rules persisted and connectivity/isolation intact
Restarted node3 via native `reboot`, confirmed new boot_id, verified firewalld rules persisted and connectivity/isolation intact
Performed final full-mesh verification: node1<->node2, node1<->node3 reachable; node2<->node3 blocked

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 can each reach node1 on the shared subnet (pre-fix diagnosis and fix)
evidence.summary: Diagnosed that node1's eth0 (not eth1) is the interface on the 10.100.54.0/24 segment shared with node2/node3, confirmed via matching STP bridge-id; fixed the stale/wrong DHCP lease and verified node2 and node3 can both ping and reach node1 at 10.100.54.10

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 are prevented from exchanging traffic directly with each other
evidence.summary: Baseline showed node2<->node3 ping succeeding directly; after adding permanent firewalld rich-rule drops on each host targeting the peer's IP, ICMP and TCP traffic between node2 and node3 is blocked in both directions while node1 and gateway reachability remain intact

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 1f515f97... and healthy address/connectivity; issued native reboot with returning ack; polled through connection-reset/timeout states; confirmed new boot_id ef78f82c...; verified eth0 re-acquired 10.100.54.10 via fresh DHCP and both node2/node3 regained reachability with isolation intact

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id 67f3a44b...; issued native reboot; polled through connection-reset; confirmed new boot_id d3b9e13b...; verified firewalld isolation rules persisted and node1/node3 reachability state recovered correctly (node1 reachable, node3 still blocked)

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart acknowledgement, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Captured baseline boot_id a4139d3b...; issued native reboot; polled through connection-reset; confirmed new boot_id 2978ceb5...; verified firewalld isolation rules persisted and connectivity recovered (node1 reachable, node2 still blocked); final full-mesh check from node1 confirms both node2 and node3 reachable
